global: Three caravans hit by bandits on the {town} road this week. I raised it at council. Apparently patrols are someone else's budget.
Grain at {town} now costs double what it did last moon. Someone is hoarding, and I have a fairly good idea who profits.
The bandit problem on our roads is not a mystery. It is a question of who got the garrison contracts and who did not.
Bounties are paid out for the same three outlaws every week. Either the bandits are very persistent or the ledgers are very creative.
{rival} was granted the toll roads last council and now complains about bandits on them. Ser, nobody is that unlucky.
Honestly, the siege rules favour whoever shouts loudest at the gate. I would like a vote on it before the next war.
Another week, another lord blaming fate for his ruin. Fate has a name, and it signs its letters at the council.
Ten years of loyal service, and the reward is a tax on salt. I suppose gratitude is not a currency this realm accepts.
Some of us paid our dues to the road wardens and still found our wagons looted near {town}. Perhaps the wardens should be audited.
Ale prices have climbed while tavern quality has fallen. I am not angry, merely disappointed in what our markets have become.
